prompt: how do large language models like ChatGPT work

plan.title: How ChatGPT Works: Just Predicting the Next Word
plan.description: Large language models like ChatGPT generate answers by predicting one word at a time. Learn how training on huge amounts of text turns simple next-word prediction into fluent conversation.

beats.narration: ChatGPT doesn't know what it's about to say. It only guesses the next word, then the next, over and over.

props.text: It just guesses the next word.

beats.narration: It learned by reading enormous amounts of text, and practicing one game: hide a word, predict it, and adjust when it's wrong.
After billions of tiny corrections, those guesses become fluent answers. It's pattern prediction, not thinking. Impressive, but worth double-checking.
